properties.description: flow_report returns entry_points and exit_points: the steps at the lowest and at the highest step_order, several when steps share a position, none when no step states an order. A step added later moves the exit with it. Flow.entry_point / exit_point and Capability.is_entry_point / is_exit_point are retired from the schema and the tools. A caller still sending one is refused by name, and a stored value is removed by the open or import repair and reported.
properties.name: A flow's entry and exit are computed from its step order and never stored
